question.text: Saraswati Long-Short AIF is a Category III hedge fund with a committed corpus of INR 150 crore. What is the minimum sponsor/manager continuing interest required under SEBI (AIF) Regulations, 2012?

answer.text: INR 7.5 crore (5% of corpus OR INR 10 crore, whichever is LOWER)
INR 10 crore (flat minimum regardless of corpus)

explanation.text: The Logic: For Category III AIFs, sponsor/manager continuing interest is not less than 5% of corpus or INR 10 crore, whichever is LOWER. 5% of INR 150 crore = INR 7.5 crore, which is lower than the INR 10 crore cap, so INR 7.5 crore is the minimum. The commitment must be a fresh investment in the scheme, cannot be by way of waiver of management fees or transfer of stocks, and is locked-in until distributions to investors are completed. The Trap: Option A uses the Cat I/II percentage (2.5%). Option C treats INR 10 crore as a flat floor, ignoring 'whichever is lower'. Option D doubles the percentage. Note: Apply the formula: lower of (5% of corpus) or INR 10 crore for Cat III; sponsor capital is first-in, last-out.
